properties.title: only governance can call pause
properties.statement: For every caller that is not `governance()`, and for all arguments (and any ETH sent), `pause` reverts.
properties.rationale: pause (line 50) reverts on a comparison of msg.sender with governance.
properties.scope: all callers outside the set, all arguments, from the setup state

properties.title: only governance can call unpause
properties.statement: For every caller that is not `governance()`, and for all arguments (and any ETH sent), `unpause` reverts.
properties.rationale: unpause (line 55) reverts on a comparison of msg.sender with governance.
properties.scope: all callers outside the set, all arguments, from the setup state

properties.title: only governance can call setGovernance
properties.statement: For every caller that is not `governance()`, and for all arguments (and any ETH sent), `setGovernance` reverts.
properties.rationale: setGovernance (line 60) reverts on a comparison of msg.sender with governance.
properties.scope: all callers outside the set, all arguments, from the setup state

properties.title: deposits never decreases
properties.statement: No call, by anyone, with any arguments, makes `deposits` smaller (it is only ever increased: deposit).
properties.rationale: every write of deposits is += or ++.
properties.scope: every function that writes deposits, any caller and arguments, from any state reachable in prover.depth-1 steps

properties.title: totalDeposits moves exactly with the balanceOf it sums
properties.statement: Every call changes `totalDeposits` by exactly the total change of `balanceOf` over the accounts it touches (the caller and every address argument): nothing is created or lost in between. Transfers leave `totalDeposits` unchanged.
properties.rationale: balanceOf and totalDeposits are written together in deposit, withdraw.
properties.scope: every function that writes either, any caller and arguments, from any state reachable in prover.depth-1 steps

properties.title: deposits moves exactly with the balanceOf it sums
properties.statement: Every call changes `deposits` by exactly the total change of `balanceOf` over the accounts it touches (the caller and every address argument): nothing is created or lost in between. Transfers leave `deposits` unchanged.
properties.rationale: balanceOf and deposits are written together in deposit.
properties.scope: every function that writes either, any caller and arguments, from any state reachable in prover.depth-1 steps

properties.title: the contract always holds at least totalDeposits in ETH
properties.statement: After any sequence of calls (by anyone, with any arguments), the contract's ETH balance is at least `totalDeposits`: what it owes is always backed (deposit add, withdraw pay out).
properties.rationale: totalDeposits grows in payable deposit and shrinks where ETH is sent (withdraw).
properties.scope: bounded: every sequence of prover.depth calls over harness.steps from the setup state (Halmos); unbounded where the SMTChecker proves it; fuzzed by forge

properties.title: pausing loses nothing
properties.statement: `pause` and `unpause` change no balance and no public state except `paused`: the contract's ETH and every public number, address and flag are the same before and after.
properties.scope: from any state reachable in prover.depth-1 steps; public no-argument getters and the ETH balance (mappings are covered by the AST fact that pause writes only the flag)

properties.title: deposit is stopped while paused
properties.statement: Once `pause` ran, `deposit` reverts for every caller and argument.
properties.scope: any caller and arguments, after a pause from any state reachable in prover.depth-1 steps

properties.title: withdraw: no storage write after an external call
properties.statement: `withdraw` makes external calls (call with ETH line 37); every storage write happens before the first call.
properties.rationale: a write after an external call lets the callee re-enter while the state is stale (the classic reentrancy pattern).
properties.scope: static: the solc AST of the function, its modifiers and the internal functions it calls

properties.title: emergencyWithdraw: no storage write after an external call
properties.statement: `emergencyWithdraw` makes external calls (call with ETH line 46); every storage write happens before the first call.
properties.rationale: a write after an external call lets the callee re-enter while the state is stale (the classic reentrancy pattern).
properties.scope: static: the solc AST of the function, its modifiers and the internal functions it calls
